sourceCommitBinding: Coordinator verified all six published Git blobs against the local snapshot; native files and Package.swift match the review hashes.
scope: Same-frame image/geometry provenance, live capture and tracking lifecycle, source/authority boundaries. No reviewer test execution or hardware qualification.

findings.original: An already-published observation could pass the saved-gate validator after tracking loss and recovery because tracking revision was private and the world/generation remained unchanged.
findings.resolution: First loss of established normal tracking atomically deactivates the delegate and retires the capture world. Explicit restart creates a new world. validateCurrent checks actual live owner, epoch, world, OS permission, app activity and tracking; saved-gate validation no longer claims live freshness.

findings.original: The public observation initializer checked JPEG digest but accepted declared dimensions/orientation without decoding the image; a four-byte pseudo-JPEG fixture passed construction.
findings.resolution: ImageIO now checks actual JPEG type, count, source completion, header and decoded dimensions, and EXIF orientation; a generated real JPEG replaces the pseudo-image. Invalid, resized and rotated image cases are explicit negatives.

additionalReviewedFixes: ARC-owned lifetime holder invalidates delegate, pauses ARSession and removes the notification observer.
Delayed app-inactive callback is fenced to its original capture generation.
One encoded pending frame and 2 Hz admission retain backpressure.
Camera transform, intrinsics and AR timestamp originate from the same captured frame; encoding does not rotate, crop or resize.
Rigid finite pose and intrinsics validation preserve phone-only client-unverified/unregistered semantics.

limitations: Read-only source review, not a native runtime result.
No physical camera, pose quality, glasses registration, private host bridge, model chain or production qualification.
